_comment: THE MANDATE — the single source of truth for what this desk is allowed to be. The config-drift sentinel compares the live config against this file every heartbeat; any divergence pages. Changing a value here IS the change-control act: it must be committed to git with a reason, which is what makes drift auditable. The desk's three recorded loss modes were all silent config drift.

delegation.text_of_grant: ฉันขอพูดตรง บางอย่างคุณทำได้เลยไม่ต้องถามฉัน ทุกเรื่อง เพราะรันบน TESTNET
delegation.meaning: The operator (Claude) may make and execute desk decisions on TESTNET without per-decision approval, including governance rulings recorded below, PROVIDED every ruling is written to git before it takes effect.
never_delegated: anything touching MAINNET or real funds — always the owner
removing or weakening the testnet lock in tradeGuard
editing ratified study thresholds after a result exists
re-arming autoTradeSignal outside the ratified GO process

autotrade_command_door.question: After the directional line closed (H-AUTO-1), may office agents still open trades via the agent-invoked `autotrade` command?
autotrade_command_door.ruling: OPEN, as the Practice-Trade Layer the owner endorsed on 21 Jul ('แบบนี้แหละที่ต้องการ') — testnet practice within the caps below is training, not edge-seeking. The caps in this file bind it; drift pages.
autotrade_command_door.note: The 2026-07-27 XRPUSDT trade (-$0.06, scratch fee-bleed) was within mandate and is the motivating example for the BE-buffer fix.

xsec_momentum_class.question: Is cross-sectional beta-netted momentum a new hypothesis class, or directional TA in new clothing?
xsec_momentum_class.ruling: NEW CLASS (it nets market direction; the closed line predicted direction), BUT any test must be pre-registered single-spec (k=60 only), multiplicity-adjusted for the 4-k peek already on the ledger (look #14), and must state universe survivorship as a known optimistic bias. NOT scheduled — parked until a survivorship-corrected universe exists.

reopen_precommit_H_AUTO_1.commitment: Option (a): the fixed-exit variant of H-AUTO-1 runs EXACTLY ONCE, pre-registered as look #17 (H-AUTO-1-R1), same signals pipeline, same ratified gates, charged to the look ledger. No second variant, no parameter exploration, regardless of how close the result lands to zero.
reopen_precommit_H_AUTO_1.sober_prior: Even perfect cost recovery lands near +0.08R gross at t~1.6 — below every gate. The expected outcome is a cleaner NO-GO, not a GO.
